passives.name: Tenacious Greed
passives.description: (Passive Effect) When an enemy inflicted with Bleeding ends their turn, reduces the duration of buff(s) granted to all enemies inflicted with Bleeding by 1 turn. When all allies except for the caster have been killed, reduces damage taken, increases damage dealt, and does not take Weakness Gauge damage. Does not take Weakness Gauge damage and reduces damage taken from targets inflicted with a debuff.
